game_concept: A action puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the oasis keeper must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Test Gauntlet: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: In Caravan Camp, repeat each round: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones. Each round, a new camel feed challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tests value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 270 points of camel feed by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 270, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Test Gauntlet
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Test Gauntlet' (Week 9 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Caravan Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Caravan Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 270 within 71 seconds.
